case_hook: First meeting; Mimi has a plan and has misplaced phone.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Children have learned the practical first step in any maternal plan.
needed_story_value: Introduce warmth, competence with fallibility; phone stays missing until Case11.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep phone/confident plan; replace bloated secure-filing conceit and emergency-book tangent.

case_hook: Evidence wall must have space for selected earned items.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo claims wall space before he has facts; family measures his ambition against the wall.
needed_story_value: Playful shared-table ownership before cases; no extra wall instructions.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep theories vs evidence tension; remove cushions/shelves and explanatory taxonomy.

case_hook: Internally released envelope; establish Delivery position.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio prepares a whole getaway before establishing how anyone arrived.
needed_story_value: Let reader meet theory-loving brother and pragmatic siblings.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep minivan/tunnel nucleus and margin; give Alio enthusiasm rather than list-style exposition.

case_hook: Returned Cup, blank handoff, find Max companion.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio recognizes over-innocent behavior because family knows his own version.
needed_story_value: Ground suspicion in family experience without declaring anyone guilty.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace trophy personality/paperwork sequence with Alio wanting to inspect it and sibling recognizing him.

case_hook: Compare two complete room photographs for ten changes.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Nini invents Inspector Glitter; Dilo realizes this suspiciously low-effort job suits him.
needed_story_value: Relief from precision task; Luli joins joke yet keeps photos in play.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep naming and job anxiety; remove explanatory admiration and filler instructions.

case_hook: Sealed evidence box misplaced; identify Pixel room companion as contact.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo turns his box vigilance into opportunity to order Alio about; Mimi knows this tactic.
needed_story_value: Family roles rub together around unopened box; do not solve carrier or invite opening.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace interrogating box and blink contest; no generic suspicions with paperwork.

case_hook: Six-symbol locker has awakened under table; code unknown.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo adopts unsolved locker as personal challenge; sisters notice selective sharing of credit.
needed_story_value: Competition with affection, final badge button; preserve unknown sequence.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Retain competition but replace briefing a door/conflict-of-interest abstraction with Dilo stake.

case_hook: Four marks establish pattern but route incomplete.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo wants printer clarity; family knows he would reject an easy answer.
needed_story_value: Breathe between acts; archive departure has forward motion.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep easy-answer reversal and unnamed-things confusion; remove fictional printer correspondence/reference check.

case_hook: Expected dragon tooth proves to be spoon; label/object discrepancy.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Nini refuses to waste dragon drawing; older siblings get reluctantly involved.
needed_story_value: Let fantasy be enjoyed without rewriting case truth.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep dragon cook/margin permission but make rescue of drawing a physical want; Bibi joins play.

case_hook: Giant moon costume missing; room snapshot next.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio checks tiny cupboards; Nini knows obvious size issue; mother has been following him.
needed_story_value: Show physical family investigation outside case table.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep cupboards and brooms kernel, replace stilted triumph and repeated drama commentary.

case_hook: Reach prop room using currently permitted route.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio sells shortcut by time saved; family notices whose labor makes it work.
needed_story_value: Route humor from practical inconvenience; no answer to route choice.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace building negotiations and load-bearing-wall fantasy with helmet confidence versus closed passage.

case_hook: Classify zero marks; Bibi recognizes but must verify.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Family sees Bibi holding memory back; Alio tests same privilege with cake promise.
needed_story_value: Give senior mentor uncertainty and agency; warmth without mocking age.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep memory/knowledge distinction and self-promised cake; end on Alio self-own, not explanation.

case_hook: Two claimants and rover, resolve access via Dash companion.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo could fix cable but cannot resist watching robot; Luli catches proprietary attachment.
needed_story_value: Tech enthusiasm becomes family friction; neither claimant prejudged.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace multiple-owner cable/personified robot with Dilo eyeing rover and sister reading him.

case_hook: Phone recovered beside oat bar while sorting case bag.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Mother tries undercover excuse; children want it preserved beside her instructions to them.
needed_story_value: Pay off intro and let parent lose small argument gracefully.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep strong undercover/source exchange; add only concrete sibling leverage and mother counteroffer.

case_hook: Parrot repeats access words but keeps requesting snack.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo follows interview form while Nini listens to actual witness.
needed_story_value: Distinct human/bird timing, youngest gets perceptive role; no feeding without handler.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep snack-budget nucleus; remove abstract witness consistency and biscuits for theories.

case_hook: Camera moved; fox theory exists only on Alio scrap.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Luli spots fox pocket problem; Nini helps outfit fox instead of refuting it.
needed_story_value: Sisters are playful collaborators, not only evidence police.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep equipment problem but remove exhaustive fox disproof and compulsory evidence tail.

case_hook: One remembered journey cannot fit travel times, not proof of lying.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Luli admits her own confident misremembering; mother and brother turn lunch story against her.
needed_story_value: Allow exacting sister fallibility while keeping kindness toward witnesses.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep three-books lunch; replace clock arrest and moralizing explanation.

case_hook: Backpacks helpfully swapped before bus departure.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Mimi low-tech fix competes with Alio expensive solution; son catches mother in own phone habit.
needed_story_value: Mother and son can win different parts of exchange.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Retain cardboard vs satellite contrast; remove theme tune and technical feature list.

case_hook: CURRENT hat beside box; old photo needs building/year verification.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio wants shelter under brim; Mimi reveals inherited family hat defense; Bibi owns her style.
needed_story_value: Three generations tease affectionately; current hat cannot date photo.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace misleading past-tense detective-under-hat line and evidence lecture; keep architecture/rent gently.

case_hook: Ticket handoff at station; helmet on Alio current head.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio has packed for adventure but is barely through ticket hall; grandmother recalls his packing priority.
needed_story_value: Station-specific physical banter; older woman can play along without lecturing.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace departments/promotion/train points with actual headgear, queue, bags.

case_hook: Dilo watch fast; multiple clocks require correction.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo protects dignity of watch while conceding his own reaction was worse.
needed_story_value: Growth in accepting corrections; sister offers practical help and small tease.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep owner pivot and tiny Nini turn; no professionalism explanation.

case_hook: Checkout logged with rare book still on shelf; scanner context.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo declines to deploy ghost; Luli notices his growth and almost misses teasing him.
needed_story_value: Show earned change after corrected clocks; one imaginary ghost sufficient.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Retain deferred digital ghost/Wi-Fi button; remove granting ghost evidence access.

case_hook: Wet panel moved; smear resembles pear only in Nini imagination.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Nini and Dilo bait mother into seeing face in paint.
needed_story_value: Let Mimi join childish perception instead of rejecting creativity.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace third object-alibi scene with invitation to see pear and mother accidental agreement.

case_hook: Dilo tore brittle note; scraps on evidence mat, nobody laughs.
comic_or_emotional_premise: No comic premise; siblings keep him in work after accident.
needed_story_value: Repair confidence with practical inclusion; Bibi uncertain handwriting must remain unconfirmed.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep quiet joins/support; replace lectures and paper interview, no forced apology.

case_hook: Three similar instrument cases returned to wrong shelves.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio thinks he can memorize cases by appearance; sister rotates them mentally; Nini likes labels.
needed_story_value: Music-specific awkward confidence without renaming evidence.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace witness-protection conceit, fake careers and bedtime metaphor.

case_hook: Wristbands swapped near arcade; Dilo distracted by scoreboard.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo hears challenge in displayed score; family can drag him away but not quite end rivalry.
needed_story_value: Keep a singular very strong compact comic exchange.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Retain number/In a tone intact; give Luli actual brother-level bargain instead of task narration.

case_hook: Track fading mud rather than misleading tread arrow.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio pauses theory himself; sister joins quiet; mother needs evidence of unprecedented household event.
needed_story_value: Payoff to theory growth and mother phone loop, not lecture.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep voluntary pause/family album; remove words put in mud mouth and theory manners.

case_hook: Unaddressed parcel repeatedly moved by helpers; identify Nori contact.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Every family member tries to help without moving parcel until Alio volunteers for snacks.
needed_story_value: Household temptation reenacts local problem at safe scale.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Replace parcel holidays and unauthorized-help officialdom; keep useful snack turn.

case_hook: Fourteen selected complete maps recalled; Case01 excluded.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo proud of stack; Luli discovers he has displayed it to visitors; Bibi backs him.
needed_story_value: Celebrate earned work with family delight before new extraction.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep impressive stack and table/elbow; avoid implying every saved map is in selected14.

case_hook: Use empty rooms in selected14 completed maps.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Nini gives attention to absence; Luli enjoys quiet witness and mother knows her own talking habit.
needed_story_value: Change perspective, avoid giving letters/instruction; family shared joke not extra teaching.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep nobody/favorite witness but rebuild mother reply as pointed familiarity.

case_hook: Old map needs overlay alignment after recovery of archive tools.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio negotiates small physical permission; Bibi is severe about maps and soft about his eagerness.
needed_story_value: Archive tactility and grandmother affectionate authority.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep heroic finger and earned tools, remove bureaucratic permission summary.

case_hook: Sort fact/theory/assumption to restore RuleZero.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Alio admits decorative confidence on card; adults recognize their own grander names for same habit.
needed_story_value: Humility across generations, earned callback to tunnel; no solution word.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep decorative confidence and experience admissions, remove explanation of what makes them funny.

case_hook: Largest final map; companion plus coordinate still unknown.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Small quiet joke only: Dilo offers silence and Luli offers him help keeping it.
needed_story_value: Family settles around reader; reassure through actions, no pressure or pre-solve.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep space/time/support, replace measuring silence as boast with generous offer.

case_hook: Four fields draw only earlier earned material; before door opens.
comic_or_emotional_premise: Dilo saving victory sound; siblings can barely contain own excitement.
needed_story_value: Earned climax with reader in charge; no answers and no premature opening.
retain_replace_diagnosis: Keep inward noises and grandmother backing; stop before lock/author reveal.
